correctness.rationale: For all integer q_i>=2, d>=3 and at least two distinct q_i, the Laplacian decomposition gives a strictly positive product resolvent on each edge-incidence factor. Its exact edge-gradient marginal sums give A_i; the diagonal Green mass is the rational subset sum alpha_i and gives B_i. Algebraically comparing i,j with q_i<q_j proves A_i>A_j. The cycle comparison reduces to a decreasing three-denominator kernel under independent Bernoulli mixing; every pair except (2,3) has a direct nonnegative lower bound, and any third factor supplies a strictly positive lower bound for (2,3). Endpoints follow from matrix symmetry. An independent grounded-Laplacian checker has verified all 579 edge columns on seven mixed graphs; finite tests are supporting evidence and not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2023 cycle-space article is read in its relevant Hamming-graph sections: its Theorems 43 and 45 concern equal-size Hamming powers and the binary cube. The present theorem gives all mixed-alphabet products in at least three factors, including the nontrivial strict ordering of both complementary projection column norms by alphabet size; neither existing homogeneous formulas nor two-factor rook formulas logically implies that ordering or the multi-factor diagonal subset sum. Semantic scientific-record and source searches returned nearby homogeneous Fourier and graph results but no covering statement. This supports best-knowledge originality but cannot establish universal uniqueness.

value.rationale: Nonuniform Hamming boxes are canonical inhomogeneous Cartesian product metrics; exact cut/cycle Hodge projection endpoint norms measure the stability of canonical edge-space decompositions in transportation-cost and finite Lipschitz settings. The theorem classifies a full infinite multiparameter family by a finite rational sum with no dependence on graph-size enumeration, and the strict smallest-alphabet extremizer law for both complementary projections is a structural result that does not arise by substitution into the homogeneous calculation. The three-factor threshold resolves the two-factor exceptional (2,3) ordering mechanism, giving mathematical content beyond a routine recomputation. It does not assert optimality among all projections.
